question: Which of the following words has been named the ‘2020 Word of the Year’ by Cambridge Dictionary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Quarantine.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Quarantine" has been named the 2020 Word of the Year by the Cambridge Dictionary.
 
• Cambridge Dictionary's data shows it was one of the most highly searched words on its website this year.
 
• "Quarantine" was closely followed by "lockdown" and "pandemic" on the shortlist for Word of the Year.
 
• Earlier in Nov 2020, Collins Dictionary said "lockdown" was its Word of The Year in 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Merriam-Webster has announced “pandemic__" as its 2020 word of the year.
